purpose: Governed transition relationship between A334 (fixed assignment), A591 (sovereigns to core engines) and A592 (sub-sovereign elimination). Read-only planning registry; it does not grant runtime effect.

A334.subject: machine-readable-sovereign-hierarchy-module-assignment-and-signature-special-law
A334.role: legacy fixed assignment: sovereign_hierarchy_registry + module_assignment_registry are the machine authority

A591.subject: sovereigns-become-core-engines
A591.role: target: five core engines (decision / permission / system-runtime / synchronization / xingcheng), one-to-one duties, codex-first

A592.subject: sub-sovereign-elimination-full-modularization
A592.role: target: sub-sovereign layer eliminated; functions map to single-purpose modules; registry/manifests/permission routes synchronised

A604.subject: authority-convergence
A604.role: successor of A591/A592: converged authority article under which modular dispatch rows are now bound

current_implementation.assignment_model: A604 modular dispatch (module_assignment_registry.managing_sub_sovereign = 'none-single-purpose-module-dispatch' for all 17 rows)
current_implementation.runtime_path: sovereign -> single-purpose module dispatch (A604 rows) -> executor
current_implementation.evidence: codex DB measured 2026-09-23: sovereign_hierarchy_registry 19/19 retired; module_assignment_registry 17/17 re-pointed to none-single-purpose-module-dispatch; architecture_registry has no owner_sub_sovereign column

target_architecture.assignment_model: A604 (successor of A592) dynamic capability matching
target_architecture.runtime_path: core engine -> capability match by task -> single-purpose module -> governed execution
target_architecture.evidence_requirement: architecture_registry owner_sub_sovereign retired; module manifests and permission routes synchronised

transition_preconditions: A591/A592 formal rules leave 'proposed' and reach declared-pending-evaluator-parity with machine evaluators — SATISFIED 2026-09-22 (evaluator-parity-verified / parity VERIFIED); provisions since superseded by A604 (active 2026-09-22T16:21:08Z)
equivalence mapping (13 owner_sub_sovereign values -> single-purpose modules) recorded and reviewed
module manifests, architecture_registry and permission routes prepared for owner_sub_sovereign retirement
new dispatch contract defined and parity-tested against the legacy fixed-assignment resolution
no runtime request is simultaneously controlled by A334 fixed assignment and A604 dynamic matching
transition_acceptance: PREPARED: mapping + preconditions recorded (registry file + blueprint section)
PARITY_VERIFIED: dispatch parity evidence for every mapped module (legacy resolution == capability match)
CUTOVER_READY: registry/manifest/permission-route changes staged and reversible; exclusivity check enforced
ACTIVATED: new dispatch contract takes current runtime effect (explicit governor activation)
LEGACY_RETIRED: sub-sovereign identities retired in codex (registry switched first); legacy assignment rows removed

stage_evidence.PREPARED: equivalence mapping recorded (this file); A591/A592 superseded by A604 (active 2026-09-22); FR-SOVEREIGN-TO-CORE-ENGINE / FR-NO-SUB-SOVEREIGN-ALL-MODULES evaluator-parity-verified (parity VERIFIED); dispatch parity v2 semantic-code evidence recorded (43 modules, 17/17 fixed-assignment parity) — full runtime dispatch wiring pending CUTOVER gate

rules.no_deletion_before_registry_switch: sub-sovereign identities must not be deleted before the registry is switched (codex-first); DB measured 2026-09-23: sovereign_hierarchy_registry already 19/19 retired and assignment rows re-pointed under A604
rules.single_model_per_request: each runtime request is governed by exactly one assignment model; A334 while current_stage < ACTIVATED, A604 dispatch contract only from ACTIVATED
rules.cutover_gate: the new dispatch contract gains current runtime effect only when PARITY_VERIFIED and CUTOVER_READY evidence is complete
rules.no_article_expansion: no new articles are required for this transition; A604 (successor of A591/A592) plus existing A334 controls are sufficient

equivalence_mapping.target: single-purpose tool/module ownership (model-dialogue, ai-assistant, ai-collaboration, file-sorter, investment-mobile, vaultly, business-logic-csharp)
data-platform modules (postgresql, qdrant, local-vector, local-model, xingcheng stores, native-compute-core, model-training)
